name: The Chronicles of Frazzemor
body:
Author Frazzemor, elf, NG; Language elven.
Alphabet elven; DC 18; Pages 334 Price 6,038 gp; Weight 7.8 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This autobiography of the elf wizard, Frazzemor, chronicles his life long struggle against the drow. The manual is bound in leather and written on parchment. It serves as the basis for much of the surface world’s knowledge of drow culture, magic, physiology and religion. Meticulously documented and researched, Frazzemor devotes nearly his entire life story to the study of his underworld cousins, only sparingly mentioning his family background. Only six copies of this manual are rumored to exist, drow agents destroyed the rest, hoping to preserve their secrets.

The reader receives a +2 insight bonus to all attack rolls and saving throws against the drow.

MISINTERPRETATION

Misinterpretation The reader receives a -1 insight penalty to all all attack rolls and saving throws against the drow.

Gross Misinterpretation The reader receives a -2 insight penalty to all all attack rolls and saving throws against the drow.

Ink & Quill. Copyright 2002, Bastion Press, Inc. Author: Thomas Knauss. Comments
